description: A dietary supplement blend contains an ingredient component represented by a Compound node. Compound targets may represent a specific chemical structure or a chemical class or family.

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Date and time the relationship was created or updated.

common_properties.name: category
common_properties.description: NHANES ingredient component category: "Vitamin", "Mineral", "Other", or "Amino acid". When contributing components for the same blend–compound relationship have differing categories, the value is "Other".

source_contributions.scope: Non-botanical components in the NHANES Dietary Supplement Ingredient File (DSBI): vitamins, minerals, amino acids, and the heterogeneous "Other" category. Botanical components are excluded. Only components mapped to existing Compound nodes are represented.
source_contributions.description: DSBI lists ingredient components of dietary supplement blends. Compound assignments use curated, human-reviewed mappings produced through an LLM curation pass. Components without a resolved Compound target are not represented. Each relationship represents a unique blend–compound pair.
